subject: Leadership recap: strategic goals, top risks, procurement path — Medicorp
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morris <emorris@medicorp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Aug 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Leadership recap: strategic goals, top risks, procurement path — Medicorp

Hi Elena — thanks again for taking time today with the leadership team. Quick recap from our side to lock in alignment and next steps for the execs.

Summary of business outcomes you emphasized
- Reduce model inference latency for customer-facing features from ~850ms to <=120ms (peak 95th pct).
- Cut per-token inference cost by at least 40% on monthly baseline for real-time flows.
- Maintain or improve model output fidelity for critical financial-response prompts (regulatory accuracy is non-negotiable).

Top risks you called out
1) Procurement timeline and legal approval window (finance + legal need 6–8 weeks).
2) Security/compliance evidence (SOC 2 + network architecture details).
3) Integration complexity for prefix cache and routing with your existing API gateway.

Proposed procurement path (high level)
- Pilot (4–6 weeks): Dedicated pool for a single product team, SLA light, performance validation.
- Pilot review & decision: Executive review board to decide on dedicated commit.
- Contracting & security: finalize MSA + SOC2 evidence, allocate security qs.
- Procurement sign: PO or reserved capacity agreement for Q4 deploy.

Immediate next steps (action owners & dates)
- Sean: Send Mutual Action Plan (attached) and initial SOC2 one-pager by EOD today.
- Marissa: Draft proposed pilot SLOs and cost estimate for 4–6 week pilot (ETA Wed 8/11).
- Elena: Share final list of technical stakeholders + preferred procurement cadence (ETA Tue 8/10).
- Ben: Coordinate a 30-min security sync with your InfoSec once we have the squad list (proposed 8/12).

Escalation lane (if timeline slips)
- If procurement stretches beyond 10 business days after pilot review, Marissa will request an exec-level commitment call to unblock legal/finance.

Attachments: RC-4721_MutualActionPlan.xlsx (action grid), SOC2-Redwood-summary.pdf (evidence highlights), sample SOW template.

Questions for your execs we should proactively answer
- Which outcomes are mandatory vs nice-to-have for Q4?
- Who signs the PO (finance or product ops)?
- Any upcoming audits that would change evidence requirements?

Thanks — I’ll follow up with the MAP and SOC2 summary. Happy to jump on a short meeting with your procurement/legal if that speeds things up.

—Sean
Sean Gallagher
Senior Sales Lead, Redwood Inference
sean_gallagher@redwood.com | (415) 555-0132

From: Elena Morris <emorris@medicorp.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Tom Park <tpark@medicorp.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2027 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Leadership recap: strategic goals, top risks, procurement path — Medicorp

Thanks Sean — this is very clear and aligns with what we discussed. Quick notes from our side:

Confirmed priorities
- Latency target is mandatory (<=120ms 95th) for the customer flow; everything else is secondary.
- Cost reduction target is a strong preference but we will accept trade-offs if fidelity is at risk.

Procurement & timelines
- Our procurement window is tight: finance wants an agreed pilot SOW + estimated monthly spend before they start the PO process.
- Legal needs SOC2 + data residency statement to start review.

Added stakeholders
- Tom Park (cc) will own the PO/contracting path on our side — he prefers DocuSign for signatures and needs a PO template to confirm internal fields.

Action items from Medicorp
- Elena: Share technical stakeholders and any audit dates (I’ll get those to you by Tue 8/10 EOD).
- Tom: I’ll put procurement on standby for a PO once we have pilot costs.

I’m attaching a short procurement timeline (MediCorp_procurement_timeline.pdf). We’ll review your MAP tomorrow and get back with any missing pieces.

—Elena
Elena Morris
VP, Product Operations — Medicorp
emorris@medicorp.com | (212) 555-0168

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morris <emorris@medicorp.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Tom Park <tpark@medicorp.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Aug 2027 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Leadership recap: strategic goals, top risks, procurement path — Medicorp

Elena / team — thanks, forwarding the MAP and an initial pilot SLO/cost sketch. I’ve taken Sean’s notes and put a realistic pilot runbook below (first pass).

Pilot runbook (4–6 weeks)
- Scope: one customer-facing endpoint (5k RPS burst safe), pinned model variant (quantized) for cost/time predictability.
- SLOs: 95th latency <=120ms, availability >=99.5% for pilot window, token-cost target ~40% below current baseline.
- Measurement: we’ll provide token-level cost dashboards and 1-min latency histogram per route.
- Data & security: VPC peering or private link is possible for pilot; for a quick start we can run on Redwood Dedicated in your region.

Security evidence summary (attached SOC2-Redwood-summary.pdf)
- High-level: SOC2 Type II attestation, encryption at rest and transit, audit log retention options.
- What we can deliver immediately: SOC2 summary, architecture diagram, data flow map, and a short redaction policy we use for PII.

Procurement pathway (detailed)
1) Pilot MAP sign: sign-off from product lead + ELT sponsor.
2) Pilot start: Redwood issues invoice for pilot (net30) or we accept your PO-based flow if required.
3) Pilot review: deliverables include performance report and go/no-go checklist.
4) Commit phase: execute reserved capacity agreement or monthly usage contract; DocuSign link can be used for the MSA.

Escalation thresholds (what triggers an exec call)
- Pilot misses 95th latency target for 3 consecutive days.
- Legal asks for evidence we can’t deliver within 10 business days.

Attachments included: RC-4721_MutualActionPlan.xlsx, SOC2-Redwood-summary.pdf. Also dropped a HubSpot deal link in the related links for tracking.

Next steps (owners & dates)
- Marissa: Finalize pilot SLO + cost (this morning, 8/11).
- Sean: Set up a 30-min security sync for 8/12 with Medicorp InfoSec.
- Tom: Please share your PO template (Ben, can you confirm fields we need?).

If it helps, I can prepare a one-page executive note that your ELT can use to greenlight the pilot — will deliver by EOD.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com | (650) 555-0189
